root_motivation: **Who:** an agent that just received a mcphost URL and must show its user a webhook arriving inside one session; the truth-tier integration_specialist persona that scores it. **What:** one call that yields a public hook URL plus a way to read the next event. **Why not today:** the webhook-inbox recipe was three host steps plus a signed POST (eight calls to show one event); a key-less call after a successful host.redeem minted a second tenant because /mcp is stateless; kind=inbox routed to the agent-inbox recipe; llms.txt had no webhook section. **Consequence:** satisfaction 0.0 / completion 0.0 for this recipe on 10-09 and 10-06.
user_persona: An agent (customer) that calls host.webhook_inbox.create once, pastes the url into a sender and shows its user the push event in the same session; the truth-tier integration_specialist persona whose gold is reachable in 4 calls; Operator Joe reading the digest.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given a free tenant, When `host.webhook_inbox.create(name="inbox")` is called once, Then the response carries `url` matching `^https://[^/]+/hook/[A-Za-z0-9]{10,}$`, `secret`, `tool: "inbox"`, `trigger_id`, and `wait.tool == "host.msg.wait"`, and `host.trigger.list` shows exactly one webhook trigger bound to `inbox`.

Given the inbox from AC1, When a POST signed with `secret` carrying `{"id":"evt-fixture-1"}` reaches `url`, Then within 5 s `host.tool_call(name="inbox")` returns a row with id `evt-fixture-1` and `host.msg.wait` with `wait.args` returns a message whose `data.event_id` is `evt-fixture-1`.
Given an unsigned or wrongly signed POST, When it reaches `url`, Then the response is 401, no row is stored, no run fires and no inbox message is sent.

Given a peer that completed `host.redeem` 5 s earlier, When it sends `host.tool_publish` without `tenant_key` on `/mcp`, Then the error is `tenant_key_missing` with `data.tenant` equal to that namespace, the `tenants` row count is unchanged, and a peer with no redeem in 10 minutes still gets implicit signup.

Given a keyed `host.quickstart(kind="inbox")`, When it returns, Then `recipe.name == "webhook-inbox"`, `recipe.steps` has one entry calling `host.webhook_inbox.create`, `recipes_nearby` contains `agent-inbox`, and the anonymous quickstart note contains "tenant_key on every call" and not "connection is bound".

Given `www/llms.txt`, When `scripts/www-check.sh` and `handler::llms_txt_tool_names` run, Then a section `## Webhook inbox in one call` names `host.webhook_inbox.create`, and `examples/webhook-inbox/proof.sh` against a local `TestServer` exits 0 in under 30 s.

Given a tenant at `event_triggers_max`, When `host.webhook_inbox.create` is called, Then the error is `plan_limit` with `data.limit == 3` and no tool, trigger or event row was created; Given a second create with the same name, Then the same `url` returns and `secret` is absent.

Given the first nightly truth-tier on orch after prod carries this, When `measure.json` is written, Then `recipes.by_recipe.mcphost-webhook-inbox.completion_rate` is ≥ 0.5 and its `failure_families` omit `budget` (Live; evidence: `ssh orch 'python3 -m json.tool $(ls -d ~/.local/state/synthorg/runs/truth-tier-* | tail -1)/measure.json | grep -A8 "\"mcphost-webhook-inbox\""'`)

src/peer_recent.rs (new) + AppState.redeemed_peers + src/handler.rs: 10-minute in-memory peer (IP+UA hash) map written by host.redeem; a key-less host.* call from such a peer is tenant_key_missing naming its tenant.
src/kinds/aliases.rs, src/control.rs: inbox alias, one-step webhook-inbox recipe, recipes_nearby generated from the outcome table, anonymous quickstart note states the stateless rule.

www/llms.txt (+ generated llms-full.txt), examples/webhook-inbox/proof.sh, contracts/host-tools.v1.json, contracts/deprecations.json, docs/tools.md regenerated.

tests/whin_ac0[1-7]_*.rs, tests/support/whin.rs, tests/common/mod.rs (TestServer https public scheme); kindroute_ac01, trigidem_ac07, toolname_ac08, compat_ac04_ac05 updated for the new tool/recipe shape.
non_goals: The HMAC scheme or /hook/{id} semantics beyond the github scheme addition; event-kind triggers; a stateful transport; host.webhook_inbox.remove (P2, no AC).

additional.signup_is_not_remembered: R3 says signup or host.redeem, but tests/sessbind_* pin signup followed by key-less behavior; only host.redeem is recorded (AC4's own scenario).

five_whys_trace.q: Why did the 10-09 webhook-inbox session make seven calls and never publish?
five_whys_trace.a: The recipe was three host steps with the hook URL only in step 2, and key-less quickstart answers repeated after a successful redeem.

five_whys_trace.q: Why did a key-less call after redeem not work?
five_whys_trace.a: /mcp is stateless, so no session carries the redeem; the next key-less call implicit-signed-up a second tenant.

five_whys_trace.q: Why does the fix key on the peer?
five_whys_trace.a: IP + User-Agent hash is the only identity the stateless handler has across those calls; a 10-minute memory turns the second tenant into a named refusal.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Peer hash = IP+UA or IP only?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: IP+UA (the PRD default), hashed; recorded in the PR.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Which quota gates create: event_triggers_max or schedules_max?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: Both are checked before anything is created; event_triggers_max counts event + message + webhook triggers, so the free plan's 3 trips plan_limit first (data.limit 3).
